odd_even.verdict_text: The two dips are different sizes — odd transits dip 0.006% but even transits dip 0.101% (94% apart). That is the classic sign of an eclipsing binary whose real period is twice the candidate period.

double_period.verdict_text: The light between the eclipses is flat — quadratures sit at 0.9999 and the shoulders at 1.0000, a difference of -0.013% ± 0.013%, so there is no twin-star ellipsoidal wave. That is consistent with a real planet — or with a binary whose stars are too far apart to distort each other.

uncapped_check.note: Uncapped tiebreaker (all sectors), ephemeris fixed at the cap-20 analyze solution for the persistence fold.

reclassification_note: Reclassified from the driver's mechanical LIKELY BINARY (stage-gate kill at b; raw verdict preserved in driver_verdict_raw). The (b) label rests on fold depths 0.0056% vs 0.1010% whose deepest member is 8.4% of the 1.196% BLS depth - squarely in the ratio-rule misfire class named in this report's tally corollaries (folds under ~20% of BLS depth are uninformative until stage (c) speaks; cf. TIC 349481800). Stage (c) does not sustain the label: no eclipse pair at 27.1754 d (windows 0.0736%/0.0103%, deepest = 6.2% of BLS depth) and no ellipsoidal wave (-0.013% at -1.0 sigma). What survives is a real, deep, positive persistence excess (+1.051% +/- 0.206%, 5.1 sigma; all 5 full events positive; no raw monsters) whose sector depths are inconsistent with a constant (chi2 p = 4.9e-7; carried by sectors 9-10 at ~+2.5%, sectors 1 and 13 near zero) on a thin evidence base (4 usable ranges of 11 products). Not convictable as a binary, not a phantom, not a survivor: INCONCLUSIVE, by the 349481800 route.
data_caveat: No SPOC/TESS-SPOC/QLP products exist for this star. All stages ran on the fixed pipeline's fallback set: 19 community products downloaded, the zero-centred guard excluded 8 TASOC files, and 11 GSFC-ELEANOR-LITE products (sectors 1, 3-11, 13; FFI, 1800 s cadence) were analyzed. Evidence base is a community pipeline, not SPOC; persistence has only 4 usable sector ranges and there is no coverage beyond sector 13, so the era-split tiebreaker is degenerate by construction (cap-20 and uncapped analyses are the same dataset).
